answer: Bonded collateral makes each identity costly, while correlated equivocation links evidence across a coordinated set: for k identities, the penalty scales as O(k²), not as k independent flat fines. On detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss makes a sybil swarm especially expensive, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of remaining stake. The labels pigment, basalt, and walnut can identify distinct escrow cohorts without changing this rule.
